description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 Score (%) for two different approaches to materials tokenization. The x-axis, labeled "Number of tokens," ranges from 0.6 to 1.5 and is marked with major tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)," ranges from 48 to 56, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The plot includes two lines: one in pink representing "MATTER (ours)" and another in purple representing "w/o material information." The pink line begins at a Macro-F1 Score of approximately 55% at 0.6 tokens, rises to a peak of about 57% at 1.0 tokens, and then declines to roughly 51% at 1.5 tokens. The purple line starts at approximately 52.5% at 0.6 tokens, shows a general decline with a slight peak around 0.7 tokens, and ends at about 48% at 1.5 tokens. The shaded regions around each line represent the uncertainty or variance in the scores.
